question: What is the card with the highest complexity score, considering whether it has legalities, flavor text in multiple languages, and rulings?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE CardLegalities AS (
    SELECT
        l.uuid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) AS num_legal_formats
    FROM
        legalities l
    GROUP BY
        l.uuid
),
CardForeignData AS (
    SELECT
        f.uuid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.language) AS num_languages_with_flavor_text
    FROM
        foreign_data f
    GROUP BY
        f.uuid
),
CardRulings AS (
    SELECT
        r.uuid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.date) AS num_rulings
    FROM
        rulings r
    GROUP BY
        r.uuid
)
SELECT
    c.uuid,
    (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN cl.num_legal_formats > 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END +
            CASE
                WHEN cfd.num_languages_with_flavor_text > 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END +
            CASE
                WHEN cr.num_rulings > 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        FROM
            CardLegalities cl,
            CardForeignData cfd,
            CardRulings cr
        WHERE
            cl.uuid = c.uuid AND
            cfd.uuid = c.uuid AND
            cr.uuid = c.uuid
    ) AS card_complexity_score
FROM
    cards c
ORDER BY
    card_complexity_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH MatchDetails AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_api_id,
        p.player_api_id,

    FROM

    WHERE
        m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'England Premier League' AND country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'England'))

TopScorer AS (

question: What is the player API ID, player name, goal difference, and rank of the top scorer across all home and away matches, considering the goal difference (total home goals minus total away goals)?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE PlayerGoals AS (
    SELECT
        m.home_player_1 as player_api_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as home_goals,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as away_goals
    FROM Match m
    GROUP BY m.home_player_1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.away_player_1 as player_api_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as home_goals,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as away_goals
    FROM Match m
    GROUP BY m.away_player_1
),
PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(pg.home_goals) as total_home_goals,
        SUM(pg.away_goals) as total_away_goals
    FROM Player p
    LEFT JOIN PlayerGoals pg ON p.player_api_id = pg.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id
),
GoalDifference AS (
    SELECT
        ps.player_api_id,
        ps.player_name,
        ps.total_home_goals - ps.total_away_goals as goal_difference
    FROM PlayerStats ps
),
TopScorers AS (
    SELECT
        gd.player_api_id,
        gd.player_name,
        gd.goal_difference,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY gd.goal_difference DESC) as rank
    FROM GoalDifference gd
)
SELECT
    topscorers.player_api_id,
    topscorers.player_name,
    topscorers.goal_difference,
    topscorers.rank
FROM TopScorers topscorers
ORDER BY topscorers.rank, topscorers.goal_difference DESC
LIMIT 1;

        c.constructorId

driver_points AS (

        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        SUM(r.points) AS total_points

),
top_constructors AS (

        constructor_points cp
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.forename,
        dp.surname,
        dp.total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dp.total_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        driver_points dp
)
SELECT 
    tc.constructor_name,
    td.forename || ' ' || td.surname AS driver_name
FROM 
    top_constructors tc

question: Which are the top 10 clients in district 1 based on the highest net positive impact (difference between total transaction amount and total loan amount) from their activities in the district?

WITH ClientTransactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_transaction_amount
    FROM
        client c
    JOIN
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN
        account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE
        c.district_id = 1
    GROUP BY
        c.client_id
),
ClientLoans AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM
        client c
    JOIN
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN
        account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN
        loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE
        c.district_id = 1
    GROUP BY
        c.client_id
),
ClientMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        ct.client_id,
        ct.total_transaction_amount,
        cl.total_loan_amount,
        ct.total_transaction_amount - cl.total_loan_amount AS difference
    FROM
        ClientTransactions ct
    JOIN
        ClientLoans cl ON ct.client_id = cl.client_id
)
SELECT
    cm.client_id
FROM
    ClientMetrics cm
ORDER BY
    cm.difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: What are the team IDs of the teams that have the top 5 players with the highest overall ratings in the 'Belgian First Division A' league during the 2016/2017 season?
sql:
WITH MatchData AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_api_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        hpa.overall_rating
    FROM 
        Match m
    JOIN 
        Player home_p ON m.home_player_1 = home_p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_2 = home_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.home_player_3 = home_p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_4 = home_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.home_player_5 = home_p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_6 = home_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.home_player_7 = home_p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_8 = home_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.home_player_9 = home_p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_10 = home_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.home_player_11 = home_p.player_api_id
    JOIN 
        Player_Attributes hpa ON home_p.player_api_id = hpa.player_api_id AND hpa.date <= m.date
    WHERE 
        m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Belgian First Division A') AND
        m.season = '2016/2017'
),
MatchDataAway AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_api_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        apa.overall_rating
    FROM 
        Match m
    JOIN 
        Player away_p ON m.away_player_1 = away_p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_2 = away_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.away_player_3 = away_p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_4 = away_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.away_player_5 = away_p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_6 = away_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.away_player_7 = away_p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_8 = away_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.away_player_9 = away_p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_10 = away_p.player_api_id OR 
                        m.away_player_11 = away_p.player_api_id
    JOIN 
        Player_Attributes apa ON away_p.player_api_id = apa.player_api_id AND apa.date <= m.date
    WHERE 
        m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Belgian First Division A') AND
        m.season = '2016/2017'
),
RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        team_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY overall_rating DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        (SELECT * FROM MatchData UNION ALL SELECT * FROM MatchDataAway) subquery
    WHERE 
        overall_rating IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    team_api_id
FROM 
    RankedPlayers
WHERE 
    rank <= 5
GROUP BY 
    team_api_id;
prompt_suffix:
What are the team IDs of the teams that have the top 5 players with the highest overall ratings in the 'Belgian First Division A' league during the 2016/2017 season?

WITH RECURSIVE RaceDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        r.year,
        r.round,
        r.name AS raceName,
        r.date,
        r.time,
        c.name AS circuitName,
        c.location,
        c.country
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
DriverPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        r.driverId,
        r.constructorId,
        r.position,
        r.points,
        r.laps,
        LN(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS logLaps,  -- Using the natural logarithm for example
        MIN(l.time) OVER (PARTITION BY r.driverId, r.raceId) AS bestLapTime
    FROM results r
    JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND r.driverId = l.driverId
),
ConstructorPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        r.constructorId,
        SUM(r.points) AS totalPoints
    FROM results r
    GROUP BY r.constructorId
),
TopConstructor AS (
    SELECT 
        constructorId,
        totalPoints,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totalPoints DESC) AS rank
    FROM ConstructorPerformance
),
TopDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC) AS rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            driverId,
            SUM(points) AS points
        FROM results r
        GROUP BY driverId
    ) d
)
SELECT 
    rd.circuitName,
    tc.constructorId AS topConstructorId,
    td.driverId AS topDriverId

question: What is the cumulative number of points for each constructor over the races from 2009 to 2018, and how have these points accumulated over time?

WITH RECURSIVE ConstructorPoints AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.constructorId,
        cs.raceId,
        cs.points
    FROM 
        constructorStandings cs
    WHERE 
        cs.raceId IN (
            SELECT 
                r.raceId 
            FROM 
                races r
            WHERE 
                r.year BETWEEN 2009 AND 2018
        )
),
TotalPointsPerConstructor AS (
    SELECT 
        c.constructorId,
        SUM(c.points) AS total_points
    FROM 
        ConstructorPoints c
    GROUP BY 
        c.constructorId
),
CumulativePoints AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.constructorId,
        cp.raceId,
        cp.points,
        SUM(cp.points) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cp.constructorId
            ORDER BY cp.raceId
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_points
    FROM 
        ConstructorPoints cp
)
SELECT 
    cp.constructorId,
    GROUP_CONCAT(cp.cumulative_points, ',') AS cumulative_points_over_time
FROM 
    CumulativePoints cp
GROUP BY 
    cp.constructorId;

question: What is the account ID of the account that has the highest combined activity score, where the activity score is calculated as the sum of the number of non-zero last transaction amounts and non-zero last loan amounts?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE AccountTransactions AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id, 
        date, 
        amount, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS trans_row_num
    FROM trans
),
AccountLoanDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id, 
        l.date AS loan_date, 
        l.amount AS loan_amount, 
        l.duration, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS loan_row_num
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
),
ClientDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id, 
        gender, 
        birth_date, 
        AVG(d.A10) OVER (PARTITION BY c.district_id) AS avg_age,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.district_id) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
),
AccountSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id, 
        c.gender, 
        c.birth_date, 
        avg_age, 
        client_count, 
        CASE 
            WHEN at.trans_row_num = 1 THEN at.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS last_trans_amount, 
        CASE 
            WHEN al.loan_row_num = 1 THEN al.loan_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS last_loan_amount
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN ClientDemographics c ON a.district_id = c.client_id
    LEFT JOIN AccountTransactions at ON a.account_id = at.account_id
    LEFT JOIN AccountLoanDetails al ON a.account_id = al.account_id
)
SELECT 
    account_id, 
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN last_trans_amount > 0 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) + SUM(CASE 
                    WHEN last_loan_amount > 0 THEN 1 
                    ELSE 0 
                END) AS activity_score
FROM AccountSummary
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY activity_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

What is the account ID of the account that has the highest combined activity score, where the activity score is calculated as the sum of the number of non-zero last transaction amounts and non-zero last loan amounts?

        totalPoints
    FROM 
        PointsPerDriver
    ORDER BY 
        totalPoints DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

    (SELECT driverName FROM RaceResults WHERE driverId = TopDriver.driverId) AS TopDriverName
FROM 
    TopDriver;

question: What is the first and last name of the driver who has the highest total points across all races?

WITH DriverPointsCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        SUM(r.points) AS total_points
    FROM 
        drivers d
    INNER JOIN 
        results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    GROUP BY 
        d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
    ORDER BY 
        total_points DESC
),
RankedDriversCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        DriverPointsCTE
)
SELECT 
    forename, surname
FROM 
    RankedDriversCTE
WHERE 
    rank = 1;

question: What is the average number of goals scored by each team in the most recent 10 matches of the England Premier League?

SELECT 
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    AVG(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS average_goals_scored
FROM 
    Match m
JOIN 
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN 
    Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
JOIN 
    Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
WHERE 
    c.name = 'England' 
    AND l.name = 'England Premier League'
    AND m.id IN (
        SELECT 
            id 
        FROM 
            Match 
        WHERE 
            (home_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team) OR away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team))
        ORDER BY 
            date DESC 
        LIMIT 10
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.team_long_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(m.id) > 0;
prompt_suffix:
What is the average number of goals scored by each team in the most recent 10 matches of the England Premier League?

question: What are the top-performing football players in the 2015 season based on their win, draw, and loss counts, along with their overall rating, potential, volleys, acceleration, and stamina, and how are they ranked?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE PlayerPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        m.home_player_1 as player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draw_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_games
    FROM Match m
    INNER JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE m.season = '2015'
    GROUP BY m.home_player_1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.away_player_1 as player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draw_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal < m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_games
    FROM Match m
    INNER JOIN Player p ON m.away_player_1 = p.player_api_id
    WHERE m.season = '2015'
    GROUP BY m.away_player_1
),
PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT
        p.id as player_id,
        p.player_name,
        pp.win_count,
        pp.draw_count,
        pp.loss_count,
        pp.total_games,
        pa.overall_rating,
        pa.potential,
        pa.volleys,
        pa.acceleration,
        pa.stamina
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN PlayerPerformance pp ON p.player_api_id = pp.player_id
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.date BETWEEN '2015-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
),
AggregatedStats AS (
    SELECT
        ps.player_id,
        ps.player_name,
        (ps.win_count * 3 + ps.draw_count) AS points,
        (ps.loss_count * -1) AS losses,
        (ps.win_count + ps.draw_count + ps.loss_count) AS total_matches,
        AVG(ps.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating,
        AVG(ps.potential) AS avg_potential,
        AVG(ps.volleys) AS avg_volleys,
        AVG(ps.acceleration) AS avg_acceleration,
        AVG(ps.stamina) AS avg_stamina
    FROM PlayerStats ps
    GROUP BY ps.player_id, ps.player_name
)
SELECT
    player_name,
    points,
    losses,
    total_matches,
    avg_overall_rating,
    avg_potential,
    avg_volleys,
    avg_acceleration,
    avg_stamina
FROM AggregatedStats
ORDER BY points DESC, losses ASC, total_matches DESC;
prompt_suffix:
What are the top-performing football players in the 2015 season based on their win, draw, and loss counts, along with their overall rating, potential, volleys, acceleration, and stamina, and how are they ranked?

question: What is the list of teams that performed well in the 2016/2017 season of the specified league, based on the cumulative goals they scored, and what is the average number of goals they scored per match?
sql:
WITH RECENT_MATCHES AS (
    -- Filter matches for a specific season and league
    SELECT
        m.id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal AS home_goals,
        m.away_team_api_id AS opponent_api_id,
        m.away_team_goal AS away_goals,
        m.season,
        m.league_id
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.season = '2016/2017' AND m.league_id = 9987
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        m.away_team_goal AS home_goals,
        m.home_team_api_id AS opponent_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal AS away_goals,
        m.season,
        m.league_id
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.season = '2016/2017' AND m.league_id = 9987
),
TEAM_MATCHES AS (
    -- Count the number of matches played by each team and the total goals scored
    SELECT
        tm.team_api_id,
        COUNT(tm.id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(tm.home_goals + tm.away_goals) AS total_goals
    FROM RECENT_MATCHES tm
    GROUP BY tm.team_api_id
),
TEAM_CUMULATIVE_GOALS AS (
    -- Calculate cumulative goals scored by each team over all matches
    SELECT
        tm.team_api_id,
        SUM(tm.home_goals + tm.away_goals) OVER (PARTITION BY tm.team_api_id ORDER BY tm.id) AS cumulative_goals
    FROM RECENT_MATCHES tm

JOIN Team t ON tc.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE tm.matches_played > 0
ORDER BY tc.cumulative_goals DESC;

question: What is the latest match date, total number of starts, average goals scored, average draws, and average losses for the top 10 players, along with their team's build-up play speed and build-up play passing metrics, in the "Belgium Jupiler League"?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE LeagueSeasons AS (
    SELECT
        match.id,
        match.season,
        league.id AS league_id,
        country.id AS country_id
    FROM
        Match match
        JOIN League league ON match.league_id = league.id
        JOIN Country country ON league.country_id = country.id
    WHERE
        country.name = 'Belgium'
        AND league.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
),
PlayerPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        match.id,
        match.date,
        match.home_team_api_id,
        match.away_team_api_id,
        home_player_1 AS player_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_player_1 = home_player_X1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_player_1 = home_player_X1 AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goals_scored,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_player_1 = home_player_X1 AND home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draws,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_player_1 = home_player_X1 AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
    FROM
        LeagueSeasons
        JOIN Match match ON LeagueSeasons.id = match.id
    WHERE
        match.home_team_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        match.id, match.date, match.home_team_api_id, match.away_team_api_id, home_player_1
),
TeamAttributes AS (
    SELECT
        match.id,
        match.date,
        match.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeed,
        ta.buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM
        LeagueSeasons
        JOIN Match match ON LeagueSeasons.id = match.id
        JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON match.home_team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    WHERE
        ta.date <= match.date
    ORDER BY
        ta.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    pp.player_api_id,
    MAX(pp.date) AS latest_match_date,
    COUNT(pp.starts) AS total_starts,
    AVG(pp.goals_scored) AS avg_goals_scored,
    AVG(pp.draws) AS avg_draws,
    AVG(pp.losses) AS avg_losses,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeed,
    ta.buildUpPlayPassing
FROM
    PlayerPerformance pp
    JOIN TeamAttributes ta ON pp.player_api_id = ta.team_api_id
GROUP BY
    pp.player_api_id
ORDER BY
    avg_goals_scored DESC
LIMIT 10;
prompt_suffix:
What is the latest match date, total number of starts, average goals scored, average draws, and average losses for the top 10 players, along with their team's build-up play speed and build-up play passing metrics, in the "Belgium Jupiler League"?

        l.date AS loan_date,
        l.amount,
        l.status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS loan_rank
    FROM 
        loan l
    WHERE 
        l.status IN ('A', 'B') -- Assuming 'A' and 'B' are the statuses of interest

        a.account_id,

WHERE 
    ls.loan_rank = 1
    AND aa.trans_date > ls.loan_date
    AND ls.status = 'B' -- Focusing on loans with status 'B'
    AND aa.type = 'VYPJEM' -- Focusing on withdrawals

        u.DisplayName,

    FROM

PostAndCommentCount AS (

    FROM

),
UserActivityRank AS (

        ReputationRank r
    LEFT JOIN
        PostAndCommentCount pcc ON r.UserId = pcc.UserId
)

    uar.Reputation,
    uar.TotalActivityRank
FROM
    UserActivityRank uar
ORDER BY

WITH RECURSIVE ClientTransactions AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        a.account_id,
        t.date,

    FROM

    JOIN
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN

),
ClientLoans AS (

        c.client_id,
        a.account_id,
        l.amount
    FROM
        client c
    JOIN
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN
        account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN
        loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
),
ClientSummary AS (
    SELECT
        ct.client_id,
        AVG(ct.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount,
        SUM(cl.amount) AS total_loan_amount

),
TopClients AS (

        cs.client_id,
        cs.avg_transaction_amount,

)

WITH TopHomePlayers AS (
    SELECT
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.match_api_id,
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(m.home_player_X1 + m.home_player_X2 + m.home_player_X3 + m.home_player_X4 + m.home_player_X5 + m.home_player_X6 + m.home_player_X7 + m.home_player_X8 + m.home_player_X9 + m.home_player_X10 + m.home_player_X11) AS total_score

question: What is the ranking of countries based on their average number of goals scored per match across all their leagues, and how many goals on average do the top-ranked country score per match?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE CountryGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name AS country_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_api_id) AS match_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE 0 END) AS home_goals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN m.away_team_goal ELSE 0 END) AS away_goals,
        SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals,
        SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals,
        SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Country c
    INNER JOIN League l ON c.id = l.country_id
    INNER JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
    GROUP BY c.name
),
AverageGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        (total_home_goals + total_away_goals) / (match_count * 2.0) AS average_goals
    FROM CountryGoals
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    average_goals,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY average_goals DESC) AS rank
FROM AverageGoals
ORDER BY rank;
prompt_suffix:
What is the ranking of countries based on their average number of goals scored per match across all their leagues, and how many goals on average do the top-ranked country score per match?

        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        p.Birthday,
        p.Description,
        p.`First Date`,
        p.Admission,
        p.Diagnosis
    FROM 
        Patient p
),
LaboratoryData AS (
    SELECT 
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        l.IGG,
        l.IGA,
        l.IGM,
        l.CRP,
        l.RA,
        l.RF,
        l.C3,
        l.C4

ExaminationResults AS (
    SELECT 
        e.ID,
        e.`Examination Date`,
        e.`aCL IgG`,
        e.`aCL IgM`,
        e.ANA,
        e.`ANA Pattern`,

        e.Diagnosis,
        e.KCT,
        e.RVVT,
        e.LAC,
        e.Symptoms,
        e.Thrombosis
    FROM 
        Examination e
),
CombinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.ID,
        pd.SEX,
        pd.Birthday,
        pd.Description,
        pd.`First Date`,
        pd.Admission,
        pd.Diagnosis,
        ld.Date,
        ld.IGG,
        ld.IGA,
        ld.IGM,
        ld.CRP,
        ld.RA,
        ld.RF,
        ld.C3,

    ra.account_id,
    ra.district_id

    ra.rank <= 3
    AND ra.district_id IN (1, 2, 3)

question: What detailed information, including foreign language texts, legal statuses, and ruling dates, can be obtained for the card 'Sample Card' and all related cards that share the same `multiverseId`, and how are these pieces of information structured in the result set?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE CardHierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id, 
        c.name, 
        c.type, 
        c.frameVersion, 
        c.uuid, 
        1 AS level,
        c.multiverseId
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.name = 'Sample Card'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c.id, 
        c.name, 
        c.type, 
        c.frameVersion, 
        c.uuid, 
        ch.level + 1,
        c.multiverseId
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN CardHierarchy ch ON c.multiverseId = ch.multiverseId
),
ForeignTexts AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.uuid, 
        ft.text AS foreign_text
    FROM foreign_data ft
    WHERE ft.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM CardHierarchy)
),
LegalStatuses AS (
    SELECT 
        l.uuid, 
        l.format, 
        l.status
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM CardHierarchy)
),
RulingDates AS (
    SELECT 
        r.uuid, 
        r.date AS ruling_date,
        r.text AS ruling_text
    FROM rulings r
    WHERE r.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM CardHierarchy)
)
SELECT 
    ch.uuid,
    ch.name,
    ch.type,
    ch.frameVersion,

question: What detailed information can be retrieved about a specific race, including the constructors, drivers, circuit details, and qualifying times, and how are the results organized in the final output?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE RaceSummary AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        c.name AS constructor_name,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        r.year,
        r.date,
        r.url AS race_url,
        r.circuitId,
        c.constructorRef,
        c.url AS constructor_url,
        d.driverRef,
        d.url AS driver_url,
        res.position,
        res.positionText,
        res.points,
        res.laps,
        q.position AS qualifying_position,
        q.q1,
        q.q2,
        q.q3,
        cs.points AS constructor_standings_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceId = q.raceId AND res.driverId = q.driverId
    LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId AND c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
    WHERE r.raceId = 18  -- Example race ID
), CircuitInfo AS (
    SELECT
        ci.circuitId,
        ci.name AS circuit_name,
        ci.location,
        ci.country,
        ci.lat,
        ci.lng,
        ci.alt,
        ci.url AS circuit_url
    FROM circuits ci
    WHERE ci.circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM races WHERE raceId = 18)
), RaceDetails AS (
    SELECT
        rs.raceId,
        rs.race_name,
        rs.constructor_name,
        rs.driver_name,
        rs.year,
        rs.date,
        rs.race_url,
        rs.circuitId,
        ci.circuit_name,
        ci.location,
        ci.country,
        ci.lat,
        ci.lng,
        ci.alt,
        ci.circuit_url,
        rs.position,
        rs.positionText,
        rs.points,
        rs.laps,
        rs.qualifying_position,
        rs.q1,
        rs.q2,
        rs.q3,
        rs.constructor_standings_points
    FROM RaceSummary rs
    JOIN CircuitInfo ci ON rs.circuitId = ci.circuitId
)
SELECT
    rd.raceId,
    rd.race_name,
    rd.constructor_name,
    rd.driver_name,
    rd.year,
    rd.date,
    rd.circuit_name,
    rd.location,
    rd.country,
    rd.lat,
    rd.lng,
    rd.alt,
    rd.circuit_url,
    rd.position,
    rd.positionText,
    rd.points,
    rd.laps,
    rd.qualifying_position,
    rd.q1,
    rd.q2,
    rd.q3,
    rd.constructor_standings_points
FROM RaceDetails rd
ORDER BY rd.raceId, rd.position, rd.constructor_standings_points DESC, rd.laps DESC;
prompt_suffix:
What detailed information can be retrieved about a specific race, including the constructors, drivers, circuit details, and qualifying times, and how are the results organized in the final output?

    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.district_id = 1

LoanAmounts AS (

Summary AS (

    FROM LoanAmounts l
    LEFT JOIN TransactionAmounts t ON l.client_id = t.client_id
)

FROM Summary

ORDER BY total_amount DESC

question: What is the cumulative number of goals scored by the player with `player_api_id = 155782` in each season for each team, and how is this information ordered?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE PlayerMatches AS (
    -- CTE to get all matches where the player has participated
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        m.home_team_api_id,
        m.away_team_api_id,
        m.home_player_X11 AS home_player_id,
        m.away_player_X11 AS away_player_id,
        m.season,
        m.date
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.home_player_X11 IN (SELECT id FROM Player WHERE player_api_id = 155782)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        m.home_team_api_id,
        m.away_team_api_id,
        m.home_player_X11 AS home_player_id,
        m.away_player_X11 AS away_player_id,
        m.season,
        m.date
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.away_player_X11 IN (SELECT id FROM Player WHERE player_api_id = 155782)
),
PlayerGoals AS (
    -- CTE to get all goals scored by the player in each match
    SELECT
        pm.match_id,
        pm.home_team_api_id,
        pm.away_team_api_id,
        pm.home_player_id,
        pm.away_player_id,
        pm.season,
        pm.date,
        CASE
            WHEN pm.home_player_id = 155782 AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            WHEN pm.away_player_id = 155782 AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS goal
    FROM PlayerMatches pm
    JOIN Match m ON pm.match_id = m.id
),
CumulativeGoals AS (
    -- CTE to calculate cumulative goals scored by the player in different leagues
    SELECT
        pg.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        pg.season,
        SUM(pg.goal) OVER (
            PARTITION BY pg.home_team_api_id, pg.season
            ORDER BY pg.date
        ) AS cumulative_goals
    FROM PlayerGoals pg
)
-- Final query to select the cumulative goals scored by the player in different leagues
SELECT
    team_api_id,
    season,
    cumulative_goals
FROM CumulativeGoals
ORDER BY team_api_id, season;

        COUNT(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 1 END) AS wins,

        constructorId, constructor_name
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name) > 1
)

    wc.constructor_name,
    wc.total_wins,
    tdc.top_driver_count

WITH FRPMData AS (

        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name`,
        f.`District Name`,
        f.`School Name`,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS K12_Percent_Eligible_Free,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS K12_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS Ages517_Percent_Eligible_Free,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` AS Ages517_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
        s.enroll12 AS K12_Enrollment,
        s.NumTstTakr AS K12_TestTakers,
        s.AvgScrRead AS K12_AvgScrRead,
        s.AvgScrMath AS K12_AvgScrMath,
        s.AvgScrWrite AS K12_AvgScrWrite,
        s.NumGE1500 AS K12_NumGE1500
    FROM
        frpm f
    LEFT JOIN
        satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
        AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
),
RankedFRPMData AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        `County Name`,
        `District Name`,
        `School Name`,
        K12_Percent_Eligible_Free,
        K12_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
        Ages517_Percent_Eligible_Free,
        Ages517_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
        K12_Enrollment,
        K12_TestTakers,
        K12_AvgScrRead,
        K12_AvgScrMath,
        K12_AvgScrWrite,
        K12_NumGE1500,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY K12_Enrollment
            ORDER BY K12_Percent_Eligible_FRPM DESC
        ) AS K12_Rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY K12_Enrollment
            ORDER BY Ages517_Percent_Eligible_FRPM DESC
        ) AS Ages517_Rank
    FROM
        FRPMData
)
SELECT
    `County Name`,
    `District Name`,
    `School Name`,
    K12_Rank,
    Ages517_Rank,
    K12_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
    Ages517_Percent_Eligible_FRPM,
    K12_AvgScrMath
FROM
    RankedFRPMData
WHERE
    K12_Rank = 1
    OR Ages517_Rank = 1
ORDER BY
    K12_Rank, Ages517_Rank;

WITH PatientExamination AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        p.Birthday,
        p.Description,
        p.`First Date`,
        p.Admission,
        p.Diagnosis,

        e.Symptoms,
        e.Thrombosis
    FROM 
        Patient p
    JOIN 
        Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
),
FilteredExaminations AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.ID,
        pe.Birthday,
        pe.SEX,
        pe.Description,
        pe.`First Date`,
        pe.Admission,
        pe.Diagnosis,
        pe.`Examination Date`,
        pe.`aCL IgG`,
        pe.`aCL IgM`,
        pe.ANA,

        pe.`aCL IgA`,
        pe.ExaminationDiagnosis,
        pe.KCT,
        pe.RVVT,
        pe.LAC,
        pe.Symptoms,
        pe.Thrombosis
    FROM 
        PatientExamination pe
    WHERE 
        pe.ANA > 256 AND 
        pe.ExaminationDiagnosis IN ('MCTD, AMI', 'SLE')
),
CumulativeANADiagnosis AS (
    SELECT 
        fe.ID,
        fe.Birthday,
        fe.SEX,
        fe.Description,
        fe.`First Date`,
        fe.Admission,
        fe.Diagnosis,
        fe.`Examination Date`,
        fe.`aCL IgG`,
        fe.`aCL IgM`,
        fe.ANA,
        fe.`ANA Pattern`,
        fe.`aCL IgA`,
        fe.ExaminationDiagnosis,
        fe.KCT,
        fe.RVVT,
        fe.LAC,
        fe.Symptoms,
        fe.Thrombosis,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fe.ExaminationDiagnosis = 'MCTD, AMI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            OVER (PARTITION BY fe.ID ORDER BY fe.`Examination Date`) AS MCTDAMI_Cumulative,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fe.ExaminationDiagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            OVER (PARTITION BY fe.ID ORDER BY fe.`Examination Date`) AS SLE_Cumulative
    FROM 
        FilteredExaminations fe
),
FinalResult AS (
    SELECT

    s.superhero_name, 
    COUNT(hp.power_id) AS number_of_powers
FROM

INNER JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

question: What is the average number of superpowers per hero for each race, but only include races that have at least one superhero with a superpower?

SELECT r.race, AVG(COALESCE(hp.power_id, 0)) AS average_powers_per_hero
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY r.race
HAVING COUNT(hp.power_id) > 0;
